scenarios.name: Collapse descendants of an extrusion with a direct sketch child

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
The MCAD Software shows a visible block made by an extrusion
the extrusion branch is expanded and shows its direct sketch child
the user right-clicks the extrusion row
the direct sketch row remains visible under the extrusion
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
